reviews.Author: Mixk
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on June 13, 2021
reviews.Text: The flavor is awesome but I do feel the value for money isn’t too great. If there was more in the package this would be a great deal but since there isn’t too much I can’t give it 5 stars.
reviews.Title: Easygoing Salt

reviews.Author: Lori Wornom
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on September 16, 2020
reviews.Text: Good salt but I wouldn’t call it flake. It’s not flaky at all like the Maldon brand. It’s more of a chunky granule
reviews.Title: Not a true flake but still good

reviews.Author: Lisaclare
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on June 21, 2019
reviews.Text: The salt was heavier than I expected it to be.
reviews.Title: If you like lighter and flakier this might not be for you
